name: Light Propagation for Multiple Anisotropic Volume Scattering
definition: A propagation approximation for light scattered into M direction bins that reduces the 'ray effect' problem found in the traditional discrete ordinates method by shooting radiosity into the whole solid angle bin instead of a discrete representative direction.
summary: Light Propagation for Multiple Anisotropic Volume Scattering is a propagation approximation that reduces ray effect artifacts by shooting radiosity into entire direction bins rather than single discrete directions.
